messages.message:
Patch Set 1:

(6 comments)

AI code review results below, please doublecheck

Some concerns, see inline comments. The ping itself does initiate recovery as intended (after_reply() -> ptlrpc_request_handle_notconn() fires only because ptlrpc_obd_ping() sets rq_send_state = LUSTRE_IMP_FULL), but reading the parameter synchronously in a helper whose whole purpose is a *bounded* wait looks like it can turn a clean timeout into a hang.

commit.subject: LU-20787 tests: wait_osp_import() to initiate recovery
commit.message:
LU-20787 tests: wait_osp_import() to initiate recovery

waiting for FULL state can find import when it hasn't detected
eviction yet. so we have to send an RPC to check it's current
state and initiate recovery if it's evicted.
this fixes spirious errors in tests like sanity-lfsck/44 when
a preceeding subtest doesn't check import's state properly.

Signed-off-by: Alex Zhuravlev <bzzz@whamcloud.com>
Change-Id: Iab7881995580033eb5efb5b930e5b0e234410761
